articles.title: In 1862, Abraham Lincoln signed a law that gave Americans a chance to claim 160 acres of free land. What happened next transformed the American West forever
articles.description: In 1862, President Abraham Lincoln enacted the Homestead Act, granting land to settlers eager to populate the West. This initiative allowed qualified individuals to claim 160 acres after five years of cultivation, significantly altering America's landscape. However, it also resulted in the displacement of Indigenous populations. The act prevailed for over a hundred years, leaving a lasting impact on the country's growth and development.

Trump ‘Ran’ With His ‘Human Binkie’; Haberman Reveals Natalie Harp’s Secret Role In Iran Scare
articles.description: Maggie Haberman has offered a striking explanation for why Natalie Harp was among the small group who accompanied Donald Trump during his secret aircraft switch in Turkey. The New York Times reporter described Harp as Trump’s “human binkie” and “comfort blanket,” highlighting the unusually close relationship between the president and his aide. Trump reportedly left Air Force One inside a catering truck before boarding a military C-32A, while several senior officials and members of the press remained on the original aircraft. Haberman also pointed to Harp’s access to Trump’s social media accounts as a possible practical reason for her presence during the covert operation.

articles.description: A New York Times report reveals how Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) refined its missile and drone tactics to exploit weaknesses in U.S. air defences during the recent conflict. The report says Iran used coordinated waves of drones, ballistic missiles, and manoeuvrable missiles to overwhelm American interceptor systems, forcing the U.S. to spend expensive Patriot missiles against low-cost Iranian weapons. It also highlights how Iran allegedly targeted key radar systems and rapidly rebuilt its missile infrastructure despite heavy U.S. strikes.

articles.title: ‘CREWS TIRED & WORN OUT’: Trump-Hegseth Face USS Lincoln REVOLT; No Apology For Sailors | WATCH
articles.description: Defense expert Bryan Clark warns that the USS Abraham Lincoln’s prolonged deployment could create a serious readiness problem for the U.S. Navy. Clark says the carrier has been deployed for nearly nine months and at sea for roughly 250 days, with difficult resupply conditions adding pressure on sailors. He warns that exhausted crews, maintenance backlogs and retention problems could leave the Navy facing a growing “human and financial” bill from the Iran war.
